newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell by 43.98 points to 5,992.48. PLDT's ADR fell by $1.25 to $59.
* The peso closed at 26.285 to a U.S.dollar from 26.280.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,041.78, down 7.81.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 11.0625 percent from 11.09375.

* Stock brokerage Sun Hung Kai Securities said that after the four percent rebound last week, it was healthy for the market to have some consolidation. Apart from taking the cue from Wall Street, investors will focus their attention on Q3 earnings. For the time being, the index might head lower, it said.

* Philippine National Bank said on Thursday it cut its forecast for full year 1996 net income to 1.7 billion pesos from 2.0 billion pesos. The announcement came after the bank announced that stripped of extraordinary gains, its nine months net profit was 993 million pesos, just four percent higher than the year-ago period.
* Bank of the Philippine Islands said on Friday it had set the offer price for its secondary shares offering at 125 pesos per share.
